purpose: Route-local representation-map rows preventing representation equivalence or uniqueness wording from becoming candidate identity.

representation_map_rows.representation_object: bulk-boundary/code-subspace representation map with quotient and public-record debt
representation_map_rows.equivalence_rule: Representation equivalence requires an explicit intertwiner, quotient, GNS/sector comparison, or public-record-preserving map; label resemblance is insufficient.
representation_map_rows.residual_gap: Unitary equivalence, algebra representation, state choice, domain, and sector/gauge movement remain residual unless tested by the route.
representation_map_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer representation uniqueness, equivalence to an interacting theory, or candidate identity from one representation map.
